name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport marketing was somewhat accidental. After graduating with a general marketing degree from the University of Stirling, he found himself drawn to the high-octane world of racing through a friend who worked as a mechanic. The technical aspect fascinated him, and he realised that his marketing skills could be put to great use in promoting teams and drivers. He started volunteering at local rally events, quickly learning the ropes of sponsorship acquisition and fan engagement.

Alistair is a firm believer in data-driven marketing. He meticulously analyses campaign performance, using insights to optimize strategies and maximize ROI. While still developing his network and honing his creative flair, Alistair's methodical approach and dedication to measurable results make him a valuable asset to any team. He is particularly interested in digital marketing strategies that can amplify a team's brand presence and reach a wider audience.

What sets Alistair apart is his quiet determination and unwavering work ethic. He's not one for flashy presentations or bold pronouncements, preferring to let his results speak for themselves. Alistair's colleagues appreciate his reliable nature and his commitment to seeing projects through to completion, even when faced with unexpected challenges.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Insists on using spreadsheets for everything, even grocery lists.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
